patrons.name: The Fiend
patrons.description: The selected alpha Patron. Fiend is the supernatural power source from level 1 and may be paired with any active Pact. The 5.x Fiend level-10 selected-type resistance and automatic Hellfire Shield are retired, not duplicated.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, or another creature reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to max(1, Charisma modifier + Warlock level). Temporary HP do not stack.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Add 1d10 after an ability check or saving throw is rolled but before resolution, at most once per roll. Uses per Long Rest: max(1, Charisma modifier). No Reaction required.

features.name: Infernal Retaliation
features.description: Use your Reaction at a time you choose without an external trigger, consuming the one shared use per Long Rest. Select one 20-round mode: Fiendish Resilience heals 1/2/5 HP per round at levels 8/13/18, or Fiendish Flamewreath deals 1d6/2d6/5d6 Fire after each qualifying melee hit within 5 feet. Ongoing effect needs no further Reactions. Resilience does not heal at 0 HP and stabilizes once if 0 HP is reached after activation. Alpha timing: healing starts at next turn start; Flamewreath resolves after each hit.

features.name: Infernal Retaliation Improvement
features.description: Increase Resilience healing to 2 HP per round or Flamewreath Fire damage to 2d6 per qualifying hit; no additional use.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Once per turn on a qualifying attack-roll hit, expend its use to force a Charisma save against the Warlock spell DC. Failure sends the target to the Lower Planes, Incapacitated and unavailable for targeting; if not a Fiend, it immediately takes 8d10 Psychic damage. It returns at end of your next turn. Success still spends the use. Recharge on Long Rest or by expending a Pact slot, with provisional no-action recharge and max one stored use.

features.name: Infernal Retaliation Improvement
features.description: Increase Resilience to 5 HP per round or Flamewreath to 5d6 Fire per qualifying hit; no additional use.
